sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180506
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40786 of 2023
Applicant :- Aamir @ Ashu

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Agrawal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Anees Baig, Advocate filed his power on behalf of the informant, today in the Court, which is
taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Arvind Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anees Baig, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Amarnath Vishwakarma, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 400 of 2023, under Sections 354, 376, 506 IPC, Police Station South, District Firozabad during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and co-accused Arif and one unknown person on 21.06.2023 under Sections 354, 376, 506 IPC and according to the FIR on 23.05.2023 applicant committed rape with the informant and thereafter on 08.06.2023 i.e. after about a year he again made sexual assault upon the informant.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that applicant and his associates also took her indecent photographs and video and threatened her to post the same on Aamir @ Ashu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60208698/
1 social media.
5.

entities.text: Aamir @ Ashu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire story narrated by the victim in the FIR appears to be quite improbable and no reliance can be placed on such version.

He further submits that even as per allegation, rape was committed by the applicant on 23.05.2022 but FIR could only be lodged on 21.06.2023 i.e. after more than a year and this fact clearly suggests that story narrated by the victim in the FIR and in her statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C.
is totally false and baseless.

6. He further submits that victim is major and married lady and she was in consensual relationship with the applicant but some dispute arose between both of them, therefore, she lodged FIR of the present case and implicated the applicant in the present matter.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 30.07.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that there is allegation of rape against the applicant in the FIR as well as in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. but could not dispute the fact that FIR of the present case was lodged after more than one year from the date of alleged rape and victim is major and married lady.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. Although, there is allegation of rape against the applicant in the FIR as well as in the statements of prosecutrix recorded during investigation but FIR of the present case was lodged after one year from the date of alleged rape.

Further, admittedly prosecutrix is major and married lady and applicant has taken a specific plea that she was in consensual relationship with the applicant and he also annexed his photographs along with the prosecutrix along with instant bail application.

10. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 30.07.2023.
11.

Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Aamir @ Ashu be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
